{{Quote|G'hengle, would you be so kind as to open up an Imperial channel.|Adar Tallon to G'hengle|<ref name="RC" />}}
'''G'hengle''' was a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] serving under [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], ''[[Silent Water]]''. G'hengle and the [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]]'s [[Unidentified Rebel lieutenant (Silent Water)|pilot]] were part of the crew during the [[Battle of Heterkus|engagement]] at [[Heterkus]].
